description: NaMg₆FeO₈ is Molybdenum Carbide MAX Phase-derived structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/mmm space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with twelve MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are four shorter (2.16 Å) and two longer (2.33 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent FeO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are two shorter (2.10 Å) and four longer (2.16 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are four shorter (2.16 Å) and two longer (2.18 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. In the third Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-15°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.23 Å. Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent FeO₆ octahedra, and edges with twelve MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are two shorter (1.94 Å) and four longer (2.16 Å) Fe-O bond lengths. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na, four equivalent Mg, and one Fe atom to form ONaMg₄Fe octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ONaMg₄Fe octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-15°. In the second O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent OMg₆ octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₄Fe octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-7°. In the third O site, O is bonded to four Mg and two equivalent Fe atoms to form OMg₄Fe₂ octahedra that share corners with six OMg₄Fe₂ octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₄Fe octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and four Mg atoms to form ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra that share corners with six OMg₄Fe₂ octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₄Fe octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and four Mg atoms to form ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra that share corners with six OMg₄Fe₂ octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₄Fe octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. Both O-Mg bond lengths are 2.05 Å.
